identity_rules: A Drive ID, repository path, local path, file-library ID, or other stable artifact identifier names an artifact identity.
Create/generate/build requests mint a new output identity even when an existing artifact has the same subject, month, audience, or filename family.
An existing artifact matching the requested subject is a preferred reference source, not an implicit mutation target.
Only an explicit update/repair-in-place instruction may authorize same-identity mutation.
